my-work.title: Entrepreneurship
my-work.description: As the Co-Founder and CTO of BRAVE UP!, I lead an AI-powered platform focused on helping schools detect, predict, and prevent bullying and cyberbullying. Through our data-driven approach, we leverage advanced technology and analytics to provide schools with the tools they need to create safer and more supportive environments for students, achieving significant results.

project-1.braveup-app-description: Web application designed to assist schools in predicting and preventing instances of bullying and cyberbullying.

project-2.braveup-website-description: Website for BRAVE UP! an edTech startup that works with k-12 schools. The purpose of this website is to showcase the functionality of the platform and act as the main point of contact for clients.

project-3.braveup-admin-description: The Admin Platform is a web tool for efficient CRUD management of entities like users and resources. It offers a dashboard, easy navigation with search and filters, ensuring both flexibility and compliance.

work.description: Founding engineer and full-stack builder. Co-founded an EdTech startup, raised $600K at roughly a $12M valuation, and took it 0 to 1 to 500+ schools and 100,000+ students across four countries as the hands-on technical lead, then shipped agent-powered products at Innovare, Glampi, and Avattar. Deep in TypeScript, React, Node, and Python, with production AI: MCP servers, agent orchestration, and RAG.

cards.title: Innovare
cards.description: Owned the AI and analytics platform end to end for K–12 schools across Illinois, building agentic workflows, MCP-powered document processing, scalable React dashboards, and modular backend services. Re-architected the LLM layer into a decoupled orchestration platform, improved reliability through validation and monitoring, and reduced dashboard load time from 40 seconds to 8 seconds.

cards.title: Glampi
cards.description: Built and owned Glampi’s booking and operations SaaS end to end using TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. Partnered directly with the founders to define technical strategy, shipped workflows that improved customer onboarding and booking by 40%, developed an OpenAI-powered natural-language search experience, and implemented secure, zero-downtime deployments using Docker, AWS CodePipeline, and Cognito.

cards.title: Avattar
cards.description: Led frontend development for ASIA, a generative AI platform using OpenAI and Gemini that reduced manual test-plan and user-story creation by 50%. Scoped and estimated 10+ client projects, improving delivery timelines by 30%, while implementing automated testing strategies that reduced post-release defects by 40% and accelerated deployments by 20% across web and mobile applications.

venture.description: Co-founded BRAVE UP! and built the platform from scratch, transforming an initial idea into an EdTech product used by more than 100,000 people across multiple countries. Raised $600K at a roughly $12M valuation, developed and scaled the technology, and learned firsthand how to build a startup and solve complex, real-world problems in school communities.

cards.title: Product Platform

cards.title: AI & Analytics
cards.description: Developed predictive models, dashboards, and analytics tools to help schools identify risks and support student wellbeing through data-driven decisions.

projects.description: Exploring ideas, building products, and transforming complex problems into simple, scalable solutions powered by AI and modern technologies.

project-1.title: DEAL ADVISOR
project-1.description: Deal Advisor is an AI-powered shopping assistant that analyzes reviews, videos, and community discussions to help people make smarter buying decisions with confidence.
project-1.summary: Full-stack application built with Next.js, TypeScript, and OpenAI. Features include real-time review analysis, video content processing, sentiment analysis, and personalized recommendations. Deployed on Vercel with PostgreSQL database on Railway. Handles thousands of product queries daily. Visit: https://www.dealadvisorapp.com

project-2.title: DATA BREW
project-2.description: AI-powered data extraction and transformation platform that converts unstructured information into structured datasets. Users can upload screenshots, documents, or raw text and instantly transform them into JSON, CSV, Excel, or SQL-ready formats.
project-2.summary: Built with Next.js 14, NestJS backend, and BullMQ for job processing. Integrates OCR technology and AI models for intelligent data extraction. Processes 1000+ documents per hour. Supabase for database and storage, deployed on Vercel with Docker containers for background workers. Visit: https://www.databrewapp.com
